name: mainsail
title: Mainsail
description: Installs Mainsail v2.18.0 as a second web frontend. Runs on port 81 by default so Fluidd stays on port 80. Set port 80 to make Mainsail primary; Fluidd shifts to 81 automatically.
tagline: Mainsail web interface alongside Fluidd, on your chosen port.

config.label: Mainsail port
config.hint: Auto-assigned. Make Mainsail primary to serve it on port 80.
